players.bio: Alex Duncan Hartridge is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle.

Alexander Paul Mitchell (born 7 October 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle, Career Mitchell began playing for New Windsor Kestrels at the age of seven. He was also a rower at his school, The Windsor Boys' School.

Aribusitamunoipirim Emmanuel "Bim" Pepple (born 25 December 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle. He has previously played for Calgary Foothills, Cavalry FC and for La Liga side Getafe. He made his EFL debut for Grimsby Town during a loan spell in the 2022–23 season.
Bradley Ryan Ibrahim (born 21 October 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle.

Caleb Roberts is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Plymouth Argyle F.C.. Highly regarded as one of the club's brightest academy prospects, he is currently out on loan at National League South side Torquay United to gain regular, competitive first-team experience.

Caleb Cassius Watts (born 16 January 2002) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle. Watts signed his first professional contract in July 2019. On 19 January 2021, Watts made his first professional appearance in Southampton's victory over Shrewsbury Town in the FA Cup.

Freddie Issaka (full name Frederick Habib Yampabu Issaka) is a 20-year-old professional footballer who currently plays as a forward/winger for National League club Gateshead FC, on loan from EFL League One side Plymouth Argyle.

Harvey David White (born 19 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle. Harvey White was born in Maidstone, Kent and attended The Holmesdale School, joining the Tottenham Hotspur Academy as a youngster.

Jack Andrew MacKenzie (born 4 July 2000) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays for Plymouth Argyle as a defender. Career MacKenzie joined Aberdeen aged 9. He was captain of the club's development side and signed a two-year contract in 2019. In March 2020, MacKenzie was due to join Atlanta United 2 on loan, but the move was cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

James Storer is a professional goalkeeper who officially left Wolverhampton Wanderers in June 2026. After spending eight years progressing through the Wolves Academy from the age of 13, the 22-year-old shot-stopper signed a permanent two-year contract with League One club Plymouth Argyle F.C..

Joseph Robert Edwards (born 31 October 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays for Plymouth as a midfielder or full-back. Edwards began his career with Aston Villa and then Bristol City, where he rose through the youth ranks to graduate from the club's academy. He made his professional debut for the club in February 2011 following a loan spell at Conference Premier side Bath City.
Julio José Pleguezuelo Selva (born 26 January 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle.

Malachi Kofi Owusu Agyeman Boateng (born 5 July 2002) is an English footballer who plays for EFL League One side Plymouth Argyle as a defensive midfielder. He came through the youth academy of Crystal Palace, and has previously played for Scottish Club Heart of Midlothian and had loan spells at Queen's Park and Dundee.
Mathias Ross Jensen is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle.
Matthew Alexander Sorinola (born 19 February 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a wing back for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle.

Michael Baidoo is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle and the Ghana national team. Baidoo began his career with the Ghanaian club Vision, and moved to the Danish club Midtjylland in 2018. Baidoo made his professional debut with Midtjylland in a 1–1 Danish Superliga tie with FC Nordsjælland on 11 March 2018.
Murphy Cooper is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle.

Owen Eric Damilola Oseni (born 7 May 2003) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for League One club Plymouth Argyle. Oseni began his career in the Ireland with Villa FC, before entering the youth sector of Waterford, as part of the WWETB FAI Player Development course. Having come through the club's youth ranks, he made his senior debut for Waterford during the 2022 season.

Ronan Curtis (born 29 March 1996) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a left-winger for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle and the Republic of Ireland national team. Curtis started his career with Derry City in 2015, spending four seasons there and amassing 100 appearances and 24 goals.

Tegan Finn (born 17 March 2008) is an 18-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a forward and wide midfielder for Plymouth Argyle. He is currently playing on loan for National League South club Torquay United. Early life Finn was born in England and attended Ivybridge Community College.

Thomas William Cleverley (born 12 August 1989) is an English professional football coach and former player who played as a midfielder. He is currently the head coach of EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle. After starting his career in the youth set-up at Bradford City, Cleverley joined Manchester United at the age of 12.
Tyreeq Jamal Adeshina Oliveira Bakinson is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle, on loan from fellow EFL League One club Leyton Orient.

Wesley Nathan Hylton Harding is a professional footballer who plays as a defender, either at right back or centre back, for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle and the Jamaica national team. He made his senior debut in the EFL Cup in August 2017 for Birmingham City, having previously played in the National League North for Alfreton Town.
William Albert Evans (born 1 July 1997) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a winger and striker for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle.
Xavier Casmier Amaechi (born 5 January 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Plymouth Argyle.
